“Remember the rainbow”

you maybe sitting at the dark room of your life right now. A lot of troubles are happening. You feel alone and hopeless. Wondering if there is God who can change your situation. You are so lonely that you feel like in this big world you are alone. Remember the creator of rainbow. He is bigger than your situations. His waiting for you to call his name! If you are just like me, God is making you wait for something that you desire in your heart for a long time, may it be a work, relationships, health, finances. There is our father in heaven. He loves to listen to our prayers. His desire and will into our life is to experience what heaven feels like while we are on earth! But the question is why there are things that are unexplainable and its hard to understand that are happening on this earth. Why there is suffering, pain, rejections and sorrows. I cannot answer that as well! But all I know is that, the one who created me knows me well. He is capable of giving me life. Lets acknowledge God into our situation and let him meet you as who you are right now! Even if you think like your life is full of mess. Remember God is gracious. Even if we do not deserved his help, his willing to pour out his abundant blessings into our life. He died on the cross for all our sins so that he can redeemed and restored our life. He made it finished on the cross already! He just want our life to be surrendered to him. 😊 In Genesis 9:13-16 “I have set my rainbow in the clouds, and it will be the sign of the covenant between me and the earth” Whenever I bring clouds over the earth and the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will remember my covenant between me and you and all living creatures of every kind. Never again will the waters become a flood to destroy all life. Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, I will see it and remember the everlasting covenant between God and all living creatures of every kind.”  

Prayer: Dear Jesus, thank you for loving me so much. I admit that my life is dark and empty without you! I give you the color pen to bring color to my life. I believe that through you, you can make my present and future life become colorful as the rainbow. Thank you for your faithfulness that is perfect and true. You never fail your promises! I give up to you my dark room and help me break the chains of negative thoughts and feelings as this is not comes from you! I only want to hear your voice and that is full of love, hope, faith, peace, joy and kindness. In Jesus mighty name! Amen.
